subject: [PATCH 53/60] mm/mempolicy: add MPOL_F_PRIVATE_NODES for private node bindings

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the documentation for MPOL_F_PRIVATE_NODES does not clearly explain how it interacts with HugeTLB mappings, and requested clarification on whether this flag can be used on HugeTLB mappings.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch adds a new flag, MPOL_F_PRIVATE_NODES, to the Linux kernel's memory policy system. The flag allows users to bind a process's memory to a private node, which behaves differently from ordinary bindings by being strict and never rebound. Private nodes are ignored in the absence of this flag. The patch also updates various functions and documentation to support this new behavior.
